description: Simple and effective element set for describing a wide range of networked resources

entities.name: Resource
entities.description: Any resource described using Dublin Core metadata
entities.note: Dublin Core describes any resource using 15 core elements (DCES) plus extended DCMI Terms. All elements are optional and repeatable.

entities.name: Title
entities.description: A name given to the resource (dc:title)

entities.name: Alternative Title
entities.description: An alternative name for the resource (dcterms:alternative). Refines Title.

entities.name: Creator
entities.description: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource (dc:creator)

entities.name: Subject
entities.description: The topic of the resource (dc:subject). Recommended practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

entities.name: Description
entities.description: An account of the resource (dc:description). May include abstracts, tables of contents, or free-text accounts.

entities.name: Abstract
entities.description: A summary of the resource (dcterms:abstract). Refines Description.

entities.name: Table of Contents
entities.description: A list of subunits of the resource (dcterms:tableOfContents). Refines Description.

entities.name: Publisher
entities.description: An entity responsible for making the resource available (dc:publisher)

entities.name: Contributor
entities.description: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource (dc:contributor)

entities.name: Date
entities.description: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource (dc:date). Recommended encoding: W3CDTF (ISO 8601).
entities.note: Refinements: created, valid, available, issued, modified, dateAccepted, dateCopyrighted, dateSubmitted

entities.name: Type
entities.description: The nature or genre of the resource (dc:type). Recommended vocabulary: DCMI Type Vocabulary.

entities.name: Format
entities.description: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource (dc:format). Recommended vocabulary: Internet Media Types (MIME).

entities.name: Extent
entities.description: The size or duration of the resource (dcterms:extent). Refines Format.

entities.name: Medium
entities.description: The material or physical carrier of the resource (dcterms:medium). Refines Format.

entities.name: Identifier
entities.description: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context (dc:identifier). Should conform to a formal identification system.

entities.name: Bibliographic Citation
entities.description: A bibliographic reference for the resource (dcterms:bibliographicCitation). Refines Identifier.

entities.name: Source
entities.description: A related resource from which the described resource is derived (dc:source)

entities.name: Language
entities.description: A language of the resource (dc:language). Recommended encoding: RFC 4646 / ISO 639.

entities.name: Relation
entities.description: A related resource (dc:relation). Related resources should be identified using formal identification systems.
entities.note: Refinements: isVersionOf, hasVersion, isReplacedBy, replaces, isRequiredBy, requires, isPartOf, hasPart, isReferencedBy, references, isFormatOf, hasFormat, conformsTo

entities.name: Coverage
entities.description: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, spatial applicability, or jurisdiction (dc:coverage). Recommended vocabulary: TGN for spatial, W3CDTF/Period for temporal.

entities.name: Spatial Coverage
entities.description: Spatial characteristics of the resource (dcterms:spatial). Refines Coverage.

entities.name: Temporal Coverage
entities.description: Temporal characteristics of the resource (dcterms:temporal). Refines Coverage.

entities.name: Rights
entities.description: Information about rights held in and over the resource (dc:rights). Typically addresses intellectual property rights.

entities.name: Access Rights
entities.description: Information about who can access the resource or its security status (dcterms:accessRights). Refines Rights.

entities.name: License
entities.description: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource (dcterms:license). Refines Rights.

entities.name: Audience
entities.description: A class of agents for whom the resource is intended or useful (dcterms:audience)
entities.note: DCMI Term (not part of the original 15 DCES elements). Refinements: educationLevel, mediator.

entities.name: Provenance
entities.description: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation (dcterms:provenance)
entities.note: DCMI Term (not part of the original 15 DCES elements).

entities.name: Rights Holder
entities.description: A person or organization owning or managing rights over the resource (dcterms:rightsHolder)
entities.note: DCMI Term (not part of the original 15 DCES elements).

dcmiTypeVocabulary.Dataset: Data encoded in a defined structure
dcmiTypeVocabulary.Image: A visual representation other than text
dcmiTypeVocabulary.InteractiveResource: A resource requiring interaction from the user
dcmiTypeVocabulary.MovingImage: A series of visual representations imparting an impression of motion
dcmiTypeVocabulary.PhysicalObject: An inanimate, three-dimensional object or substance
dcmiTypeVocabulary.Service: A system that provides one or more functions
dcmiTypeVocabulary.Software: A computer program in source or compiled form
dcmiTypeVocabulary.Sound: A resource primarily intended to be heard
dcmiTypeVocabulary.Text: A resource consisting primarily of words for reading

relationTypes.isVersionOf: The described resource is a version of the referenced resource
relationTypes.hasVersion: The described resource has the referenced resource as a version
relationTypes.isReplacedBy: The described resource is supplanted by the referenced resource
relationTypes.replaces: The described resource supplants the referenced resource
relationTypes.isRequiredBy: The described resource is required by the referenced resource
relationTypes.requires: The described resource requires the referenced resource
relationTypes.isPartOf: The described resource is a part of the referenced resource
relationTypes.hasPart: The described resource includes the referenced resource
relationTypes.isReferencedBy: The described resource is referenced by the referenced resource
relationTypes.references: The described resource references the referenced resource
relationTypes.isFormatOf: The described resource is a format of the referenced resource
relationTypes.hasFormat: The described resource has the referenced resource as a format
relationTypes.conformsTo: The described resource conforms to the referenced resource

dateTypes.created: Date of creation of the resource
dateTypes.valid: Date of validity of the resource
dateTypes.available: Date that the resource became or will become available
dateTypes.issued: Date of formal issuance of the resource
dateTypes.modified: Date on which the resource was changed
dateTypes.dateAccepted: Date of acceptance of the resource
dateTypes.dateSubmitted: Date of submission of the resource

vocabularyEncodingSchemes.DCMIType: DCMI Type Vocabulary - categorizes the nature or genre of the resource

syntaxEncodingSchemes.Box: DCMI Box - regions in space defined by geographic coordinates
syntaxEncodingSchemes.ISO3166: ISO 3166 - codes for names of countries
syntaxEncodingSchemes.ISO639-2: ISO 639-2 - three-letter codes for names of languages
syntaxEncodingSchemes.ISO639-3: ISO 639-3 - three-letter codes for names of languages
syntaxEncodingSchemes.Period: DCMI Period - time intervals defined by their limits
syntaxEncodingSchemes.Point: DCMI Point - points in space defined by geographic coordinates
syntaxEncodingSchemes.RFC4646: RFC 4646 - tags for the identification of languages
syntaxEncodingSchemes.RFC5646: RFC 5646 - tags for the identification of languages
syntaxEncodingSchemes.W3CDTF: W3C Date and Time Formats (profile of ISO 8601)
